Visa Requirements
What type of visa I need to visit Mapua University?
Please follow through this link https://evisa.gov.ph/page/policy
What visa I need to visit foreign institution?
a) Visit to Southeast Asian Countries and Taiwan not exceeding 14 days does not require a visa. b) Visit to other countries please send mail to ilrad@mapua.edu.ph
What documents do I need to prepare for visa application as outbound student?
a)   Invitation letter b)   Birth Certificate issued by PSA c)    Bark Certificate showing six (6) months record; d)    Passport showing validity of at least six (6) beyond the intended stay at the foreign institution; e)    Notarized affidavit of support in case bank certificate is not under the name of student applicant; f)    Active Certificate of Matriculation; g)   Original Certificate of Grades with dry seal; h)    Endorsement to the Embassy from the Office of the President; I)    2 pcs current photos (passport size or 2 x 2 with white background, or as required by the country of destination taken       within 3 months); j)    Other additional requirements, please send email to ilrad@mapua.edu.ph or mcbironia@mapua.edu.ph
Students Under International Sandwich Program and Other Students Who are Non-Degree Seeking Students
Item No. Duration of Stay Requirements 1 Less than 6 months ACR I-Card Waiver (for stay of 59 days or less) Round trip Air Ticket Special Study Permit (SSP) Tourist Visa Valid Passport 2 For than 6 months but less than 1 year Long stay tourist visa SSP I-Card
All Types of Degree Seeking Foreign Students
Student Visa (9F) except of those whose age is below 18years old which requires only SSP and ACR-I.
